description: prometheus/mysqld_exporter 0.15/0.16 command line, rendered as one flag per line.

fields.description: host:port of the mysqld to scrape; filled by the server from topology.
fields.name: mysqld_address
fields.title: MySQL address

fields.description: Account used for scraping; needs PROCESS, REPLICATION CLIENT and SELECT.
fields.name: mysqld_username
fields.title: MySQL user

fields.description: Password for that account; filled by the server. Never rendered into the flags file — it is passed as MYSQLD_EXPORTER_PASSWORD or written into config.my-cnf.
fields.name: mysqld_password
fields.title: MySQL password

fields.description: my.cnf whose [client] section holds the credentials; its options override the flags.
fields.name: config_my_cnf
fields.title: Credentials file

fields.description: Port of the /metrics endpoint (--web.listen-address).
fields.name: listen_port
fields.title: Listen port

fields.description: Exporter log verbosity.
fields.name: log_level
fields.title: Log level

fields.description: Size of the exporter's connection pool to mysqld.
fields.name: max_open_connections
fields.title: Max open connections

fields.description: Per-scraper query timeout; 0 disables it.
fields.name: query_timeout
fields.title: Query timeout

fields.description: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS — the core counter set. Upstream default ON.
fields.name: global_status
fields.title: collect.global_status

fields.description: SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES — server configuration as metrics. Upstream default ON.
fields.name: global_variables
fields.title: collect.global_variables

fields.description: SHOW REPLICA/SLAVE STATUS — replication lag and errors. Upstream default ON.
fields.name: slave_status
fields.title: collect.slave_status

fields.description: information_schema.innodb_metrics — the detailed InnoDB counters. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: info_schema_innodb_metrics
fields.title: collect.info_schema.innodb_metrics

fields.description: information_schema.innodb_cmp — compression statistics. Upstream default ON.
fields.name: info_schema_innodb_cmp
fields.title: collect.info_schema.innodb_cmp

fields.description: information_schema.innodb_cmpmem — compressed buffer pool statistics. Upstream default ON.
fields.name: info_schema_innodb_cmpmem
fields.title: collect.info_schema.innodb_cmpmem

fields.description: information_schema.processlist — per-state connection counts; costly on busy servers. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: info_schema_processlist
fields.title: collect.info_schema.processlist

fields.description: information_schema.tables — per-table size and row counts. Upstream default ON.
fields.name: info_schema_tables
fields.title: collect.info_schema.tables

fields.description: Query response time histogram (Percona/MariaDB only). Upstream default ON.
fields.name: info_schema_query_response_time
fields.title: collect.info_schema.query_response_time

fields.description: performance_schema wait events summary. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: perf_schema_eventswaits
fields.title: collect.perf_schema.eventswaits

fields.description: performance_schema statement digests — the per-query latency source. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: perf_schema_eventsstatements
fields.title: collect.perf_schema.eventsstatements

fields.description: performance_schema table I/O waits. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: perf_schema_tableiowaits
fields.title: collect.perf_schema.tableiowaits

fields.description: performance_schema index I/O waits. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: perf_schema_indexiowaits
fields.title: collect.perf_schema.indexiowaits

fields.description: performance_schema file I/O events. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: perf_schema_file_events
fields.title: collect.perf_schema.file_events

fields.description: Total size of the binary logs on disk. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: binlog_size
fields.title: collect.binlog_size

fields.description: SHOW ENGINE INNODB STATUS — parsed into metrics. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: engine_innodb_status
fields.title: collect.engine_innodb_status

fields.description: Auto-increment column headroom per table. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: auto_increment_columns
fields.title: collect.auto_increment.columns

fields.description: pt-heartbeat table based replication delay. Upstream default OFF.
fields.name: heartbeat
fields.title: collect.heartbeat

fields.description: Raw `key = value` settings appended verbatim at the end of the file; keys must match ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*$. Entry order is not preserved.
fields.name: custom
fields.title: Extra settings
